sentence.text: In Test M5 a 3-mm-thick, two-sided PMMA slab burned for the 27.2 min set, with oxygen dropping from 22.2 % to 19 % (model).
The model predicts the peak carbon monoxide reached about 987 ppm, exceeding the long-term SMAC (10 ppm) at T+00:17 and the 1-hour SMAC (55 ppm) at T+01:31.
The CO sensor was over-ranged (>1,000 ppm) and the long burn caused damage to the downstream lower corner of the front window where a flow-duct leak existed.
